free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed RNG seed so graph generation and the reached target decision are deterministic across runs

free_parameters.name: opset
free_parameters.why: the witness does not name an operator set; Add/Mul/ReLU are simple CPU-only ops from nnsmith.abstract.op that build a valid graph quickly

free_parameters.name: init_rank
free_parameters.why: the repository default (random_model_gen init_rank=4) and the value used by the repository's own generation tests

free_parameters.name: max_nodes
free_parameters.why: the repository default max_nodes=5 used by nnsmith graph-generation tests; stops the generation loop by node count rather than by elapsed time

free_parameters.name: timeout_ms
free_parameters.why: the default generation budget of random_model_gen; with max_nodes=5 the loop exits on node count well before this, so the target decision is reached deterministically

free_parameters.name: limnf
free_parameters.why: the witness path prefix self.limnf must be true for control to reach the target line
